annotations.limits: supply-side signals, not a load-interconnection promise — generation is not deliverable load · utility study timelines, large-load tariff processes and substation-grain delivery are declared out of coverage rather than estimated

description: Use this when the user asks when power will be available (time to power) in a US state, year by year: new generation (EIA-860M, under construction, testing and planned kept apart), scheduled retirements, and interconnection-queue depth as context. Arguments: state (required), years, mw. Supply-side signals, not a promise that a load can connect.

mw.description: Optional target MW for CONTEXT ONLY — echoed back with an explicit note; never converted into an energize-by date, which this data cannot honestly state

state.description: 2-letter US state code (required), e.g. OH, GA, TX — the timeline grain; a state can span ISOs and the response reports ISO membership as context

name: get_power_availability_timeline
title: Get Power Availability Timeline
